summary: The EPA plans to relax rules on data center pollution reporting. This change will make it harder for the public to comment on pollution. New data centers face increasing community backlash.

headline: Who are the 33 British nationals missing in Nepal

summary: Videos confirm dramatic flood survival stories in Nepal. Footage from the Trishuli river shows people escaping deadly floodwaters on balconies. BBC Verify located and verified several clips from affected areas.

headline: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
summary: The BBC has documented a week of Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank. Lucy Williamson reports on numerous attacks targeting Palestinians. The violence has been observed consistently over the last seven days.

headline: Disorder at balloon release for man who died in A66 car crash 'put lives at risk', MP says
summary: An MP stated disorder at a balloon release for an A66 car crash victim endangered lives. Police are not linking the fatal crash to a separate deadly house fire. The incident caused public safety concerns.
